stem:
Meena is helping her grandmother in the kitchen. A steel ladle is left resting in a pot of hot dal on the stove. After some time, the handle of the ladle becomes hot even though it is not touching the flame.
By which process does heat reach the handle of the ladle?

options.text: conduction, because heat passes through the metal from particle to particle
convection, because hot dal rises and carries heat to the handle
radiation, because the flame sends out heat in all directions
evaporation, because steam from the dal heats the metal

teacher.key_rationale: The ladle handle is part of the same solid metal spoon; heat travels through the solid by particle-to-particle transfer, which is conduction. Convection needs a moving fluid, radiation acts directly from the flame to a surface, and evaporation is not a heat-transfer path to the handle. Key: A.
